name: solana-pay-checkout
title: Solana Pay Checkout
description: Renders a Solana Pay transfer-request checkout with a wallet deep link, scannable QR code, reconciliation reference support, and externally verified payment states.
docs: Requires SolanaProvider from the connect-wallet-btn registry dependency. Browser wallets connect and submit SOL or SPL transfers through Wallet Adapter; mobile wallets can scan the Solana Pay QR or use the same-device link. Pass a unique reference for every order and update status only after server-side payment validation. Memos are public onchain and must not contain sensitive data.
